text.en:
Barangays Looy, Bongo, Biarong, Lamud, Kigan, Pandan, Romongaob, Basak (Upi side), Pilar,
San Jose and Itaw, all in the Municipality of Upi, Province of Maguindanao, are hereby detached and
separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and independent municipality which is created to be
known as the Municipality of South Upi without affecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother
municipality of Upi. The seat of government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Looy.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities shall be applicable to the Municipality of South Upi.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Upi shall continue to perform
their duties as such officials in the newly created municipality until the officials of the latter shall have been
appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have been
elected in the regular elections for municipal officials following the issuance of this Decree and shall have
qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and employees as
may be necessary to organize and complete the government personnel of the Municipality of South Upi shall
be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the respective proportionate share of South Upi in the
obligations, funds, assets and other property of the Municipality of Upi shall be transferred by the President to
the newly created municipalities upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders and regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
